authority: #K2-493 sec.2 item 2 required the two `clearance` items to be adjudicated with the item's OWN recorded geometry: real violation (fix the obstacle model) vs measurement-model difference (name + archive). The previous read (K2_C2_CLEARANCE_MEASUREMENT_MODEL_DIFFERENCE_v1) took the ENGINE'S capsule model as the arbiter and concluded 'measurement-model difference'. This read takes KiCad's OWN pad geometry as the arbiter and REVERSES that disposition.
method: load the chain's own board (k2i1/s2_resolved.kicad_pcb) with pcbnew, read each DRC item's real pad shape (GetShape/GetSize/GetPosition and the exact track start/end/width), and compute the exact segment-to-rounded-rectangle distance with the same geometry KiCad uses.

item_A.pad: C86:2 [GND] shape=RECT size=0.6x0.7 at (32.0,62.85) rot=0 -> half-extents (0.3,0.35), r=0
item_A.track: MCU_VDD F.Cu width 0.2 from (31.1,62.85) to (31.5,63.25) (a 45-degree escape step)
item_A.verdict: REAL VIOLATION (the engine's own exact geometry reproduces the DRC's number to 4 decimals)

item_B.track: PERSTA# F.Cu width 0.2 from (50.05,39.0) to (50.45,39.4) (a 45-degree escape step)

result.why_the_previous_read_was_wrong: the engine's obstacle model represented every pad as the INSCRIBED CAPSULE (long-axis stadium, hw = min(size)/2). An inscribed capsule is a SUBSET of the pad, so the pad's rectangular CORNER lies outside the obstacle and is invisible to the clearance test. At (31.1,62.85) the tested flank is the pad corner: the capsule read 0.250, the exact rect reads 0.1062.

fix_landed.asset: k2_pin_escape_plan_v1.pad_obstacle_shape() = TRUE rounded-rectangle pad obstacle + exact segment-to-rounded-rectangle distance in _leg_clear; k2_pin_escape_precheck_v1._true_corner_radius maps KiCad's pad shape onto r
fix_landed.shape_coverage: one representation is exact for ALL common pads: CIRCLE/OVAL (r = min/2), RECT (r = 0), ROUNDRECT (its own radius); TRAPEZOID/CUSTOM fall back to r = 0 (a superset -> can only refuse more, never falsely clear)
fix_landed.prevention_not_cleanup: the offending copper is never laid (rather than pruned afterwards), so connectivity cannot be traded away for clearance

evidence_read_only.board: k2i1/s1e_stitched_addendum.kicad_pcb (exactly the board the chain hands to the escape stage)

changed.why: was the DRC offender at C86:2
was the DRC offender at R1:2
latent third case of the same grazing geometry

evidence_read_only.reading: no pad loses its escape and no connectivity is given up; the three 45-degree steps that grazed a neighbour pad's corner become orthogonal steps that clear it by construction.

regression: test_C502_escape_clearance_uses_the_true_pad_shape (RED: the capsule model clears the step; GREEN: the true shape refuses both DRC offenders, reproduces 0.1062mm to 4 decimals, CIRCLE pads remain exactly a disc, other-layer/same-net/far copper untouched). Suite via the in-register shell: 163/163 PASS (EXIT=0).
caliber_note: the clearance floor used by the escape planner is the frozen value (clear=0.30 = the 0.20 DRC clearance + the 0.10 leg half-width); criteria rev=6 and the judging table are untouched. Nothing here changes a criterion - it changes whether the engine's own copper obeys it.
